blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Culture took center stage as candidates of Miss Asia Pacific International 2026 brought the colors, craftsmanship, and traditions of their home countries to the National Costume Competition on Sunday, September 27, at the Mactan Shrine in Lapu-Lapu City. Sri Lanka’s Sandeepa Sewmini took home the Best in National Costume title with a peafowl-inspired ensemble. The costume highlighted the importance of protecting the iconic South Asian bird while promoting sustainable fashion through the use of ethically sourced feathers. “The Sri Lankan peacock is a very famous and iconic animal.
